About Me

A Leader Who Builds People, Then Products

Bhaskar Gangipamula is a technology entrepreneur, executive leader, and community builder based in the Greater Seattle Area. With over two decades in enterprise technology, he has moved from engineering to architecture to executive leadership — always keeping people at the center.

Starting as a Senior Software Engineer at Wipro, he honed his craft before joining Microsoft, where he spent nearly two decades as a Senior Technical Program Manager and CCG Finance BI Architect — leading revenue planning, forecasting, and reporting transformation for a global channel organization.

"Our success is deeply rooted in our commitment to technological advancement and customer satisfaction."

In 2004, he co-founded Quadrant Technologies — a company he has grown into a globally recognized IT services leader with over 3,000 employees across four continents. His leadership philosophy is simple: get the right people in place, foster a culture of creativity, and remain accessible to everyone in the organization.

The Company

Quadrant Technologies

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, Quadrant Technologies has grown into a globally recognized IT services powerhouse. As Co-Founder and President, Bhaskar has been instrumental in every phase of the company's growth — from startup to industry leader.

The company holds Microsoft Gold Partner status and serves enterprise clients across high-tech, manufacturing, healthcare, airlines, and more. With a new 25,000 sq ft flagship office in Redmond — five times the size of its previous location — Quadrant is built for the next era.

A development center in Warangal, India and offices in Singapore, Mexico, and Vancouver reflect a global delivery model that provides clients with seamless, round-the-clock service excellence.
